senses.gloss: m. (דּוּר) shed, esp. for cattle, wood &c.; stable, store-house.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:1">B. Kam. VI, 1</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 191:3">Yalk. Ex. 191</cite> <he>מִדִּירוֹ</he> (Pesik. Haḥod. p. 55ᵃ <he>מדידן</he>, Var. <he>מדורות</he>, <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>מדִּירוֹת</he>) when taken directly from its stable.—Pl. <he>דִּירִים</he>.
Ned. I, 3 כד׳ (Y. a. Bab. ed., 10ᵇ, דִּירַיִים Du.) as forbidden as the Temple sheds for cattle or wood. Ib. 13ᵃ דירים; Y. ib. 37ᵃ; Tosef. ib. I, 3 דיריים.
